{{Otheruses|Pulsar}}
'''Pulsar tracking''' was a method used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to locate [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Pulsar tracking was fairly reliable for targeting large [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on a starship. It obtained less accurate readings from a spinning ship, which a brave [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] would sometimes utilise dangerously to avoid detection.
{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the revised second draft of {{Film|I}}, written and directed by [[George Lucas]], Jinn advises [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olie]] to spin in order to counter the Trade Federation's pulsar tracking during their escape from Naboo.<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> That moment was included in the film's [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] by [[Terry Brooks]].<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>
